prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create a polished professional high-fidelity mobile Android app UI design review board for the existing Chinese Lolita wardrobe app. Landscape, 3 large flat front-facing mobile screen artboards side by side, each 390:844 proportions, very high resolution, no physical phones, no perspective. Board header “我的 Lolita · 整体体验提案” and small subtitle “概念设计 · 示例内容”. Elegant fashion editorial design, functional real app not a fantasy poster. Chinese typography exceptionally legible. Existing Chinese skin direction: warm ivory #FFF8F0, dark ink #302B31, refined muted cinnabar #AE274A, pale plum blossom only at extreme corners, near-solid quiet panels, fine gold hairline only on occasional section edge. Do not blanket every card with a red outline. Restrained serif section headings, clear sans reading text, generous but practical spacing. Retain existing four bottom navigation labels 首页 穿搭 统计 个人 and recognizable house, dress, chart, settings symbols on every screen. No fifth tab.
LEFT screen: empty wardrobe, existing single-line top controls search icon then 位置 服饰 套装 心愿 then filter sort grid icons, 服饰 active. Below compact chips 全部 服装 假发 鞋履. Centered lovely original ink-and-watercolor miniature wooden wardrobe illustration with one hanging elegant dress, explicitly decorative empty-state art. Title “从第一件心爱之物开始” two tidy lines max, subtitle “照片、名称，先记下来就好”. Primary filled button “添加第一件物品”. Secondary text “从淘宝导入”. Bottom modest link “已有资料？恢复备份”. Preserve breathing room; no duplicate floating plus on this empty state. No today outfit shortcut on clothing tab.
MIDDLE screen: Laboratory goal-oriented landing, back arrow title 实验室. Compact top service status row “图像服务未配置” trailing “去配置”. Two beautiful full-width IMAGE-led action cards of equal importance stacked, 1) “生成展示图” with miniature source dress photo and isolated full dress preview side by side, small badge “效果示意”, short caption “整理商品图，用作封面或试衣”, CTA “选择物品”; 2) “虚拟试衣” with original fictional adult model in tasteful fully clothed elegant lolita dress, badge “效果示意”, subtitle “先选人物，再选这次要穿的物品”, CTA “开始搭配”. Imagery compact and functional, no celebrity, no real trademarks. Under this a grouped compact settings section “更多工具” with rows 我的模特, 假发头模图, 识图录入 and a separate row 任务中心. All functions fit by using modest height image strips. Only selected/primary actions use accent, plenty whitespace. Services row is configuration only never imply network verified.
RIGHT screen: virtual try-on workspace, back title “虚拟试衣 · 实验”. Small horizontal step labels “1 人物  2 物品  3 核对”. Compact 120dp-high person section “本次试衣人物”, Fit full-body preview of fictional adult female in gray tee and black trousers on left, text “内置虚拟模特” and action “更换” on right, actual person not cropped. Next section “本次试衣物品” with 3 clear selected full item thumbnails dress, lace blouse, shoes, each Fit entire item and short label, text “已选 3 件”, button “从衣橱选择”. Expandable row “补充穿戴要求”. Collapsed service summary “图像服务 · 已配置” with “更换”. Muted direct text “仅供效果参考，不能判断真实尺码。” Sticky action area directly above four-bottom-nav: “将发送 4 张图片及穿戴资料，另行计费。” and one primary button “核对输入与费用”. This opens a future confirmation; do not claim button generates directly or no fee. All amounts are illustrative none needed.
Outside the artboards below short captions “01 空态有明确起点” “02 按想完成的事进入” “03 首屏看见人物与物品”. Make elegant usable UI, preserve app restrained East Asian wardrobe aesthetic, no gigantic typography, no gradients overwhelming photos, no extra marketing slogans.

Use case: ui-mockup
Create a high-resolution professional mobile UI THEME comparison design board, very wide landscape about 3840x2160, fourteen complete front-facing narrow app screens in exactly seven columns and two rows, no device hardware. Header in Chinese “我的 Lolita · 七套皮肤浅暗提案”, subtitle “概念效果 · 同一实验室布局 · 非应用截图”. Each column header clear large Chinese: 甜美, 哥特, 中华, 古典, 海军, 田园, 维多利亚. Upper row light mode, lower row dark mode, labeled 浅色 and 暗色. Every screen shows the same refined Laboratory landing page structure: app bar 实验室 with back; compact service row 图像服务未配置 / 去配置; two equally important stacked action cards with short illustrative thumbnail strips of a full pink frilled dress before/after isolated and a fictional adult model fully clothed in a coordinated modest lolita outfit, tiny badge 效果示意. Card titles “生成展示图” and “虚拟试衣”, CTA “选择物品” and “开始搭配”. Compact rows below “我的模特”, “假发头模图”, “识图录入”, “任务中心”. Bottom exactly four navigation labels 首页 穿搭 统计 个人. No large paragraphs. All screens same hierarchy, same content, real legible Chinese. Light row neutral quiet photography backgrounds, dark row also keeps neutral thumbnail backgrounds and never recolors the actual garment or skin. Crisp understated typography and practical real-app proportions, no fantasy app chrome.
Each skin must have a clearly different illustrated visual identity in tiny corner art and meaningful line icons without overwhelming text:
Sweet: soft blush-white, saturated rose actions, full curved motifs and generous rounded panels.
Gothic: pale gray-purple / midnight violet, pointed arch inset illustration composition, sharp bevels and angular garment motif, violet readable accents.
Chinese: warm ivory / deep ink brown, restrained plum-branch corner marks, roofline and crossed-collar icon contours, cinnabar, long breathing strokes.
Classic: warm pearl / smoky brown, symmetrical fine pinstripes and tailored dress silhouettes, muted wine actions, restrained symmetry.
Navy: mist blue / deep midnight navy, porthole and lighthouse forms, blue actions, crisp nautical geometric composition, not fantasy anchors everywhere.
Country: oat cream / forest charcoal, sprig illustration and wide brim/apron silhouette icons, sage actions, natural curves.
Victorian: ivory / deep walnut, subdued brass accents and burgundy, layered arched photo mounting, fine frame detail limited to hero sections, tiered bodice silhouettes.
Preserve house/dress/chart/settings bottom icon meanings but apply those distinct silhouettes, not merely same art recolored. Primary information on near-solid surfaces, ornament low contrast at corners only. Existing wardrobe app premium yet practical. Every dark screenshot has readable bright text and moderately bright actions, no neon, no pure black crush. Refined designer presentation without marketing slogans or spurious charts.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit this existing three-screen Chinese app concept board. Preserve the entire visual design, all panels, all other wording, photos, proportions and board title. Make ONLY the following precise corrections:
1. Right screen, the text beside “内置虚拟模特” currently invents height, weight and body measurements (身高160cm, 体重48kg, 三围80/60/86). Remove ALL these measurements and replace this area with exactly two lines “完整人物预览” and “点击图片可放大”. Do not show any height, weight, body numbers anywhere.
2. Left empty wardrobe subtitle replace “照片、名称，先记下来就好” with exactly “把心爱之物收入衣橱” to avoid implying required form fields have changed.
3. In the bottom navigation of ALL three screens, the fourth 个人 icon must be a recognizable gear/settings outline, consistent with this app. On the middle Laboratory and right Try-on screens, highlight ONLY 个人 in cinnabar; 首页 must be gray there. On left wardrobe screen keep 首页 active. Preserve exactly four tabs 首页 穿搭 统计 个人.
4. On right screen step indicator make 人物 show a small completed check, 物品 active, 核对 inactive.
Everything else unchanged. This is a corrected conceptual UI mockup, not an implementation screenshot.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit this 7-column x2-row fourteen-screen Lolita app theme concept board. Keep exact 7 column headings, full board arrangement, each skin's background ornament, UI colors, typography and rows unchanged. Correct only the following UI visual semantics:
For ALL fourteen screens, in the top card titled 生成展示图, show ONLY two images: original pink-and-cream lolita dress hanging on a simple hanger -> the SAME dress fully isolated on a neutral ivory square. Remove all people from this top card. Exactly same garment colors across all seven skins and both modes, photos never theme tinted.
For ALL fourteen screens, in the lower card titled 虚拟试衣, show a compact single fictional adult woman in the SAME fully clothed pink-and-cream lolita outfit as a clearly illustrative thumbnail on a neutral ivory square, keep label 效果示意. Use the same garment and person in all skins without color changes. Avoid before/after claims in lower card.
Bottom tabs on every screen exactly 首页 穿搭 统计 个人. Only the 个人 tab selected in that skin's accent, other tabs muted gray, and its icon a recognizable small gear/settings outline. Preserve existing house/dress/chart icon shapes, no additional tabs.
Ensure high Chinese text legibility. Keep all existing skin individuality and restrained ornament, no new decorations or copy.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Tiny surgical correction to this existing design board. Keep every pixel arrangement, all 14 screens, titles, backgrounds, text, colors, navigation and all light-row screens unchanged. ONLY in the BOTTOM ROW of seven dark screens: inside the FIRST card labeled 生成展示图, the RIGHT thumbnail incorrectly shows a woman. Replace that right thumbnail in EACH of those seven cards with the same isolated pink-and-cream full dress on the same neutral ivory background used in the corresponding top-row screen's right thumbnail. No human may appear anywhere in those seven first cards. Leave the SECOND card 虚拟试衣 with the woman's photo unchanged. This is a product dress on hanger -> isolated dress function, not a person try-on function. ONLY these seven small rectangular thumbnail replacements.
